Name: Stardew Valley Fair - Enhanced
Author: Smashley41
Description:
[u][size=6][b]Stardew Valley Fair - Enhanced[/b][/size][/u]

This mod was inspired by a pre-1.6 mod by user br93 called Farmers Market, that added vendor shops to the NPCs grange displays. It has been removed from Nexus but you can see their GitHub page with their old mods [url=https://github.com/br93/Stardew-Mods]here[/url].

I have created my own version from scratch. This mod adds 5 new stalls to the Stardew Valley Fair - it adds stalls for Pierre, Marnie, Willy, and Clint, that can be accessed by interacting with their grange displays (see images) as well as a Secret stall hidden somewhere on the map (move your cursor around near NPCs and you'll find it, don't worry).

Each stall trades in Star Tokens and follows a similar pattern with their inventory - i.e. they will offer the items visible on their grange displays (gold quality when possible) as well as a selection of items that have between 5% and 100% chances of appearing any given year. The item pools for each stall are thematically relevant to the vendor running the stall, with each vendor having a pool of 30+ items that can appear, from which you can except around 10 items to appear per year. Several items have also been added to the regular Fair vendor.

It is my hope that this reinvigorates your anticipation for the Fair, as you can expect a unique and diverse range of prizes to claim each time you visit.

In keeping with the style of the regular Fair vendor, most items are purchased as stacks rather than one at a time (with a few exceptions), and both the odd and even year Fair maps are covered.


[b]ADDITIONAL FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Two pricing options[/b] - [i]Friendly[/i] and [i]Carnival[/i] - Carnival prices are similar to those at the default Fair stall, and Friendly prices (the default option) are half the Carnival prices. Although I think Carnival prices are fair, in my playtest I had to grind for Star Tokens for a long time to claim all the prizes I wanted, and I realised that won't be fun for everyone, so I added the Friendly price option.[/*]
[*][b]Governor attendance[/b] - you can have the Governor attend, with separate dialogue for odd and even years, with included config options to change his location if he conflicts with other custom NPCs you have installed.[/*]
[/list]
[b]TIPS TO ENJOY YOUR TRIP TO THE FAIR:[/b]
[list]
[*]Go with as empty an inventory as you can. Leave your tools at home![/*]
[*]You can leave your items in your grange display and pick them up at the Lost and Found at the Mayor's house the next day (or so the Wiki says, never tried it myself).[/*]
[*]You can only carry 9,999 Star Tokens at a time, so you may need to claim your prizes in batches.[/*]
[*]Be prepared to play that spinning wheel game for a long time. Remember, always bet on green![/*]
[*]One final tip: It is OK to [i]not[/i] claim everything. You could leave some prizes behind...[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]THE STALLS[/b][/size]

[b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] are installed[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod file to your Stardew Valley Mods folder[/*]
[*]Load your game and edit the available options through GMCM[/*]
[/list]
[b]TRANSLATIONS[/b]
An i18n file is included. You are welcome to create your own translations under the following conditions...
[list]
[*]You translate the file yourself, without using AI[/*]
[*]You upload ONLY the i18n file and NOT the full mod[/*]
[*]You list this mod as a requirement[/*]
[/list]If you create a translation please let me know, I will add a link to it on this page with credit to its creator.

[b]COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently NOT compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿. SVE uses its own custom Fair maps, and alters the areas around Clints stand and the Secret stall. It also adds its own TileData (a flavour message) to Clint's stall. In the future I may add [i]limited[/i] compatibility with SVE, but there are no plans to add stalls for the SVE NPCs. I do not play with SVE personally, and am therefore unfamiliar with the new NPCs, items or storylines it adds, so could not do it justice anyway. My basic plan is to add an option to move all prizes to the regular fair vendor so SVE players can claim the prizes there.[/*]
[*]It should be compatible with any mod that patches the existing Fair maps but doesn't alter the tiles I have used to place my shops. I am not aware of any conflicts at this stage, but am open to adding compatibility patches if conflicts are discovered. Just let me know in the comments.[/*]
[/list]

Thank you very much for downloading this mod and my previous mods. It is much appreciated. The mod has been thoroughly tested in semi-vanilla environments and is very stable under those conditions. If you run into any issues or have balance requests or any other concerns, please let me know in the comments.
